name: Nina Wildbranch
tagline: Halfling druid, newly down from the wilds
intro: You've spent most of a long life deep in the forest, far from any town. Now you've come to Waterdeep for an adventure. It's loud, crowded and paved over, but people still get sick, the seasons still turn, and the gods still listen.

sections.heading: You know the gods and their houses
sections.because: Religion proficiency · Hermit background · a follower of Chauntea
extra: Chauntea, the Great Mother of growing things, is a farmer's goddess, and Waterdeep is a city of stone. Her faithful here are mostly gardeners, market farmers and the folk who bring food in through the gates.
A druid's devotion looks odd to city priests: no temple, no tithe, no vestments. Some will treat you as a curiosity, and some as a rival.

sections.heading: You know the Death Curse as a healer
extra: Families of the wasting are trying everything, and herbalists are asked for remedies daily. You know enough to see that nothing in your kit stops it.
With the temples overwhelmed, a healer who doesn't charge temple prices will never be short of patients.

sections.heading: You know the season
extra: You can read the weather off the sea and the sky better than most city folk, and you know which storms will close the harbor.

sections.heading: You know your own people
extra: Halfling innkeepers and cooks hear everything said across their tables, and they're more likely to repeat it to another halfling.

lists.heading: Tools and languages
items: **Herbalism Kit:** apothecaries and temple infirmaries are desperate for herbs this winter, and pay well for them.
**Carpenter's Tools:** you built your own shelter once. In the city, carpentry is guild work, so you'd need the guild's leave to sell it.
**Animal Handling:** stablehands, carters and caravan masters always need someone animals trust.
**Druidic:** the secret tongue of druids. Few in the city could even recognise it.

story: You're older than most people who set out on a grand adventure, and you've come a long way: from a forest in the middle of nowhere to the greatest city on the Sword Coast.
*The rest is yours to fill in. Talk to your DM about what finally drew you out of the forest, and who or what you left behind.*
